reviewMethod: AI semantic review: every one of the 3,074 input words and recorded short senses read sequentially in 12 bounded batches, assigned individually, then all 3,074 decisions reread sequentially in 6 bounded batches. Ambiguous senses were checked against the existing source examples and explanations. Explicit per-ID amendments were made during the full second pass. No old rarity, equal-size quota, frequency list, word-length rule or generated default assignment was used.
boundaryNotes: These are practical inferred education stages, not an official nationwide per-grade vocabulary list or human linguistic certification.

0 requires elementary familiarity with the lexical word as written, not only a simple referent. Formal anatomy and less basic connectives were reassessed individually; 腹部、臀部、肋骨、心脏、头颅 and 尤其、甚至 remain outside 0. Familiar ordinary animals and foods are assessed without relying on the number or complexity of written characters.
1 also covers primary grades 2-6; ordinary school vocabulary, common descriptions and introductory biology such as 睾丸、卵子、胚胎、淀粉 can be 1 when the lexical concept belongs to general school knowledge.

2 also covers middle-school grades 8-9; common literary/classical words and standard physics, chemistry, economics and formal prose remain general education. 驷马、斋戒、眷属、廿 are 2 after independent calibration; historical origin alone does not imply 4.

3 covers specialized non-language medicine, engineering, administrative or technical knowledge, including the recorded medical senses of 畸形、糜烂、侏儒、痴呆, specific uncommon species such as 鳟鱼 and medical/technical preparations. 八卦 is 3 UNIVERSITY_ABSTRACT for the recorded Book of Changes / 巽 trigram sense, not its gossip sense.

4 is reserved for genuinely specialist Chinese-language/literary or uncommon classical study. No entry in this first 3,074-row shard needs 4 after the full review and calibration; a zero count is allowed because no per-shard stage quota applies.
completion: All 3,074 rows received an individual first-pass semantic decision and a complete second-pass review. Source CSV and all teaching fields were read-only; only this shard decision/report/progress artifacts were written. No tests, build, device or Git publication actions performed.
